brokers.note: Coded: event buses whose rules push events to API destinations (HTTPS endpoints), the target that delivers to an application's own endpoint. Other targets (AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Kinesis and others) receive the same event JSON inside another service that the consumer then reads, and are not coded as modes. EventBridge Pipes (which reads from another broker) and EventBridge Scheduler (which holds schedules) are not coded here.
